notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least nine.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying two life.
Defiler of Instinct and Aetherflux Reservoir trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Instinct trigger,  dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Razaketh by paying two life and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Razaketh ability, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
